integrity: Exact rational polynomial certificate and standalone checker; no experimental or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Universal inequality is proved for integer Erlang shapes 2 through 13, with shape 1 equality and a shape 14 counterexample; no classification is asserted for shapes above 14 or noninteger gamma laws. Existing general renewal formulas imply pointwise quantities, so publication-priority assessment is qualified.
title: Thirteen Erlang stages preserve quantum purity–overlap order; fourteen can reverse it
